verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments and merchant platform, but the evidence pack documents no account-wide export of merchant data in open formats. The APIs, SDKs, MCP server and Markdown versions of the documentation are developer building blocks or documentation access, not a first-party data-export feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
